Okay so u was really excited to try the date and senorita, so I bought the combo of date, senorita, glam and rosè. Here is my honest opinion.
(Smell is subjective and this is my point of view)

Date: initial spritz is very alcoholic smelling and smells like sanitizer for a minute or two but then the smell settles down into a fruity and floral smell. The smell is powdery and floral notes are very synthetic. However I like this perfume, it lasts a little long because the smell is strong. It can be a good night time perfume.

Rosè: I like this perfume. It’s fresh and smells like bouquet of flowers that we find during wedding decorations. The smell is again powdery and synthetic with the initial alcohol smell but when it dies down, it smells fresh. It can be a good morning perfume.

Glam: I don’t understand this smell. It’s fresh but very artificial. I can’t specifically smell anything but it smells not too bad. So I guess I don’t have the adequate knowledge to define scents like this.

Senorita: this smells like disappointed. Alcohol at first and then NOTHING. I can’t smell anything from this after the nauseous alcohol smell. 


My final thoughts are: 
1.don’t buy the bigger ones just because of the hype. 
2.Sometimes trust the negative reviews. 3.And please don’t spread positive reviews just because of sponsorship.
